supported_transports.description: Local subprocess communicating over JSON-RPC 2.0 stdin/stdout.
Remote or local HTTP/HTTPS MCP server using Streamable HTTP.

native_filtering_capabilities.tools_include: Allowlist (whitelist) of exact tool names or fnmatch globs under mcp_servers.<name>.tools.include. Takes precedence over exclude. [] disables all tools.
native_filtering_capabilities.tools_exclude: Blocklist (blacklist) of tool names or globs under mcp_servers.<name>.tools.exclude.
native_filtering_capabilities.tools_resources: Boolean flag (default true) controlling registration of list_resources/read_resource utility tools. Set to false for minimum surface.
native_filtering_capabilities.tools_prompts: Boolean flag (default true) controlling registration of list_prompts/get_prompt utility tools. Set to false for minimum surface.

native_timeouts_and_resilience.circuit_breaker: Opens after 3 consecutive failures for 60s cooldown; reconnects automatically when stdio child dies or on next call.
native_timeouts_and_resilience.credential_stripping: Stdio subprocess environment strips unrelated API keys/tokens unless explicitly passed in mcp_servers.<name>.env.
